name: Diya Enhramy
source:
Evgene lives in one world - it is a world of everyday life, work, family, modular houses, fast trains. But it wasn't always like that: he was once an esportsman, an inspired gamer with lots of friends and fun adventures. The development of virtual reality technologies and their high cost prevented him from playing with wealthier friends, one of whom was Bohdan. Recently, Bohdan appeared at a meeting of gamers. But will Evgene be able to prove that the good old games are better than the new virtuality?

[Translated from [url=https://killagram.itch.io/actionoftheengram]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
叶夫根如今生活在一个由日常琐事、工作、家人、模块化住宅和高速列车构成的世界里。从前却不一样：他曾是意气风发的电竞选手，有许多朋友，也经历过不少趣事。虚拟现实技术发展起来后，昂贵的价格使他再也没法和那些条件更好的朋友一起玩，博赫丹就是其中之一。最近，博赫丹出现在一次玩家聚会上。叶夫根能向他证明，旧日的好游戏胜过新兴的虚拟世界吗？
